resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1934 survey gives the station as a 100-foot state tower; the listing gives tower #81 as 94 feet. The record uses 28.7 m (94 feet) for tower #81. The sources do not say whether the survey measured tower #81.

The 1934 survey places the station two miles southwest of Northome on U.S. Highway 71; the note on tower #81 says its site is a short distance west of town along the same highway. The two may or may not be the same place.

notes_for_editor: Brief said gone; confirmed. The 1912 tower's fate is not stated in either source. Tower #81's removal has no date. Coordinates from the FFLA list (47.86591, -94.31458) match the Koochiching list (47.8657, -94.3144). No source describes the site beyond the ARMER note or public access.
